title: mine evidence to extend ADDR_CANON_COMMON for France
headline: ADDR_CANON_COMMON is NOT the binding constraint for France. The entire mined extension set (abbreviations + street types + ordinals) is worth 54,758 of 11,992,918 listed French address tokens = 0.4566%. Real French signal sits in geography (16.92-23.88%), function words (15.71-19.79%) and house-number digits (11.49-13.49%), all outside this table. Four genuine defects found, none of them a missing ADDR_CANON_COMMON entry.

single_most_important_number.meaning: Share of listed French address-token mass addressed by the ENTIRE proposed ADDR_CANON_COMMON extension (54,758 / 11,992,918). The dictionary is not the bottleneck.

new_defects.title: Five cross-language collisions in ADDR_CANON_COMMON applied to France
new_defects.detail: ADDR_CANON_COMMON encodes US compass/real-estate senses that are wrong for French text. normalize.py:321 removes only (st,ste,dr,n,s,e,w) for France while ADDR_CANON_FR overrides none of them.
new_defects.why_it_matters: A wrong-sense entry manufactures a token that never occurs naturally in French addresses, injecting IDF-weighted noise on every occurrence. A missing entry only loses a match opportunity. These five are worth more than all ~20 Tier-2 additions combined despite being a quarter of their mass.

new_defects.title: normalize_address never applies the LEET map that normalize_name applies
new_defects.detail: LEET defined at normalize.py:256, applied at exactly one site, normalize.py:280 inside _name_tokens. normalize_address (lines 314-353) never calls translate(LEET). Verified by scanning every line of the file for LEET: only 256 and 280 match.
new_defects.recommendation: DO NOT extend LEET to addresses. The asymmetry is real but the fix would be a regression: the mixed tokens are French house-number forms (12 bis, 2e) and street truncations (chem1), not leetspeak. Folding chem1 -> chems would be wrong.

new_defects.title: French ordinal family entirely absent from both address tables
new_defects.detail: ADDR_CANON_COMMON:184-185 has a complete English ordinal set (first->1st, second->2nd, third->3rd, fourth->4th, fifth->5th). No French counterpart exists in ADDR_CANON_COMMON or ADDR_CANON_FR.

new_defects.title: Profile tokenizer does not strip accents, unlike the production tokenizer
new_defects.detail: build_profile.py:28 TOKEN_RE=[a-z0-9]+ is applied to ba.lower() WITHOUT strip_accents. normalize.py:317 calls strip_accents() BEFORE tokenising. The two tokenisers disagree on every accented French word, so 1-char alpha tokens are largely debris, not real tokens.

evidence_fragments.smoking_gun: r = 182,872 in test_s2 vs 2,543 in test_s1. A 72x jump across sources for a 1-letter token is a tokenizer artefact signature, not a language fact.

new_defects.recommendation: Fix build_profile.py:28 to apply strip_accents() before TOKEN_RE, matching normalize.py:317, and re-run the profile build before any agent mines short tokens. Does NOT affect this task candidates, all of which are long unambiguous tokens.

france_train_rows.note: train is France-free, so the France branch of normalize_address is never exercised by train data

denominators.caveat: addr_tokens is a top-4000 list with hapax pruning (build_profile.py:140 TOPN=4000, prune() at :45-48). All three France lists are AT the 4,000 cap, so listed mass is a LOWER BOUND on true token mass and the vocabulary is truncated.

dictionaries_as_built.effective_french_map_formula: eff = {k:v for k,v in COMMON if k not in (st,ste,dr,n,s,e,w)} then union ADDR_CANON_FR  (normalize.py:319-321)

uncovered_mass_decomposition.note: Percentages are of each file France listed address mass. Buckets are mutually exclusive by construction: geography, function words, pure digits, 1-char alpha, curated street types, remainder.
uncovered_mass_decomposition.key_inference: The street_types_unhandled bucket, the ONLY bucket ADDR_CANON_COMMON is designed to address, is ~0.25% of mass, roughly 60x smaller than the geography bucket. No amount of dictionary work moves this pipeline.

tier1_apartment_family.note: The dictionary already contains apartment->apt and apt->apt. The French spelling of the same concept is simply missing.

tier2_french_street_types.placement: mostly ADDR_CANON_FR (France-only); port and villa to ADDR_CANON_COMMON (occur in US/India)
tier2_french_street_types.priority: P2 - deliberately low, this bucket cannot move the needle

abbreviation_pair_mining.method: every short token (len 2-5) x every longer token containing it, both >=300 pooled occurrences, excluding pairs already unified in the effective French map
abbreviation_pair_mining.verdict: NEGATIVE RESULT - essentially all false positives
abbreviation_pair_mining.why: The top 45 pairs are all the French function words de/des against place or person names (de~bordeaux 1050023~277474, de~gironde 1050023~150787, de~president, de~claude). de and des are function words, not abbreviations.
abbreviation_pair_mining.conclusion: The abbreviation-table opportunity in ADDR_CANON_COMMON for France is essentially empty beyond the apartment family. A purely mechanical prefix heuristic would have produced about 5,000 junk entries.

leetspeak_analysis.conclusion: These are French house-number constructions and street truncations, NOT leetspeak. Do not extend LEET to addresses.

d073_d077_reconciliation.criterion_stated: Union bound over the 14 FR_REGIONS keys. normalize_address:333 resolves state only when a whole comma-component, after re.sub of non-alnum to space and whitespace collapse, exactly equals a key. Multi-word keys therefore require ALL component tokens to co-occur. The profile discards component structure, so rows matching key k are bounded above by the min over t in T(k) of count(t); summing over the 14 keys bounds resolvable rows from above.

test_s1.note: vacuous, exceeds row count; floor at 0

loose_criterion_any_one_token.verdict: VACUOUS - exceeds the row count, so the ceiling is 100% resolvable and 0% unresolvable

d073_d077_reconciliation.verdict: D073 is RIGHT (71.10% / 28.90%), reproduced to within 0.13 pp. D077 97.4380% is NOT reproducible under either criterion and sits just above the vacuous loose-criterion line. The disagreement is a criterion artefact, not a data disagreement.
d073_d077_reconciliation.premise_correction: The work order premise that test_s2 and test_s3 encode geography with department names ABSENT from FR_REGIONS is partly wrong. gironde, nord, loire atlantique, pas de calais, somme, landes and paris ARE already FR_REGIONS keys and carry 293,000+ occurrences in test_s2. Only aisne and vendee are genuinely absent and both are 0 occurrences. The 28.77% shortfall is NOT department-table coverage. ZERO new FR_REGIONS entries are warranted.
d073_d077_reconciliation.bound_status: UNION BOUND (upper bound on resolvable), not a direct count. True resolvable <= 71.2323%, true unresolvable >= 28.7677%.

proven_no_ops.claim: The 7-key exclusion list (st,ste,dr,n,s,e,w) at normalize.py:321 is a semantic no-op for France.
proven_no_ops.method: Compared the as-built effective map against a hypothetical map built with NO exclusion list, across all 222 keys.
proven_no_ops.detail: Only s, e and w differ, and only by passing through unchanged instead of self-mapping, which is semantically identical because ADDR_CANON_COMMON defines south/s->s, east/e->e, west/w->w. All other excluded keys (st, ste, dr, n) are redefined by ADDR_CANON_FR, which is merged AFTER the exclusion.
proven_no_ops.recommendation: Do not spend effort on it.

proven_no_ops.claim: The missing FR_REGIONS self-map loop entry (normalize.py:252 omits FR_REGIONS) has zero measurable effect on this dataset.
proven_no_ops.method: Checked whether the 4 canonical values occur as input address tokens.
proven_no_ops.result: hdf, naq, pdl and idf each occur 0 times as input address tokens in all three France test files.
proven_no_ops.recommendation: Real code defect, no effect on this data. Independently re-measured, consistent with the work order. Applies to the self-map loop ONLY and must not be conflated with the department gap.

watchlist_not_recommended.note: bld means building in English and boulevard in French. Currently inert because bld is 0 occurrences in the France vocabulary.
Possible country or continent component, unhandled, no clear normalisation target
Very frequent as a trailing component; unclear whether it should be dropped as a country marker

gaps: All three France addr_tokens lists are AT the 4,000 cap. Tokens outside the top 4,000 per source are invisible. Absent from the France vocabulary and therefore UNDETERMINABLE, not estimated: national, section, imm, societe, entreprise, hame, ham, ruel, ven, espl, hll, im, traverse, montee, descente.
Component structure is destroyed by the profile builder, so every D073/D077 figure is a union bound and not a count. No exact per-row state-resolution rate is derivable.
No row-level co-occurrence: I can count token occurrences, not rows containing them. All row-level statements are bounds.
Hapaxe pruning (build_profile.py:45-48) drops count-1 tokens, so listed mass under-counts by an unknown amount.
Downstream model effect unmeasurable from the profile; all expected-effect statements are INFERENCE.
Train is France-free, so no France dictionary entry can be validated against a France ground truth and no France train/test shift can be measured.

recommendations_priority_order.action: Fix the 5 cross-language collisions in ADDR_CANON_FR: est->e, se->se, ne->ne, col->col, fort->fort. Pooled 9,538 (0.0795%).
recommendations_priority_order.rationale: Correctness fix, not a recall fix. Highest value per byte available.

recommendations_priority_order.action: Add apartment family to ADDR_CANON_COMMON: appt/app/appart/appartement -> apt. Pooled 10,128 (0.0845%).
recommendations_priority_order.rationale: Also present in India so COMMON is the correct home; apartment->apt already exists, the French spelling is missing.

recommendations_priority_order.action: Add about 18 French street types to ADDR_CANON_FR; move port and villa to COMMON. Pooled 26,966 (0.2248%).
recommendations_priority_order.rationale: Deliberately low priority, this bucket cannot move the needle.

recommendations_priority_order.action: Add French ordinals 1er/2eme/3eme/2e alongside the English set at ADDR_CANON_COMMON:184-185. Pooled 3,172 (0.0264%).
Fix build_profile.py:28 to strip accents before TOKEN_RE, matching normalize.py:317, and re-run the profile build.
recommendations_priority_order.rationale: More valuable to the fleet than anything task-specific. 2.47-2.70% of French mass is accent debris and short-token mining on current profiles yields confident nonsense.

explicitly_not_recommended: Extending LEET to addresses, it would mangle French house-number forms. Real asymmetry, wrong fix.
Adding FR_REGIONS entries, aisne and vendee are the only absent keys and both are 0 occurrences.
Touching the normalize.py:252 self-map loop, the 4 canonical values occur 0 times as input tokens.
Editing the (st,ste,dr,n,s,e,w) exclusion list, proven no-op.
A mechanical abbreviation-pair miner, 5,248 raw pairs, all false positives.

relation_to_already_checked.REFUTED-1_french_postcodes: Not re-derived. Mixed-digit token counts are consistent with it: the only digit-bearing French tokens are house numbers, not postcodes.
relation_to_already_checked.REFUTED-2_france_region: The s1-only 100% figure is NOT reproduced and NOT quoted. My France-wide figure is 71.2323% resolvable and 28.7677% unresolvable, as a union bound with the criterion stated. I agree with D073 and reject D077 under the stated criterion, and additionally show the premise that the shortfall is caused by missing department entries is itself false.
relation_to_already_checked.function_words_finding: Corroborated, not re-derived: de+la+le+les+du+des in test_s2 = 737,491 / 4,745,780 = 15.54%, against the established 731,158 / 15.41%. The difference is consistent with the established set omitting le and les.
